name: @aikanban/workspace
description: AIKanBan — a DSH plugin (host half + browser half) turning the chat harness into a project/task board. Monorepo root: build, test, and load-chain tooling.

scripts.verify: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build && node tools/verify-host-import.mjs

comment:scripts: `pnpm -r` and `pnpm -C <dir>` are used on purpose. `pnpm --filter <name> run <script>` was measured hanging indefinitely on this workspace's synchronised drive (S0-W2 hit the same thing), while -r and -C return immediately. Keep --filter out of these scripts and out of the docs.
